Building smarter ad-tech solutions that make a real impact is where I thrive. I’m driven by the challenge of turning complex data into actionable insights that drive business growth. My goal is to bridge the gap between technical innovation and practical outcomes, ensuring every project aligns with both user needs and business objectives.  

At AdLift Technologies, I focus on refining machine learning models that enhance ad performance and user engagement. The opportunity to work on dynamic, fast-paced ad-tech challenges keeps me motivated. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate abstract problems into concrete solutions that scale.  

In my short time here, I’ve contributed to streamlining data pipelines and improving model interpretability, which has helped our team make faster, more informed decisions. I’m also learning to approach problems with a balance of curiosity and pragmatism—something I’m still mastering.  

Looking ahead, I’m eager to deepen my understanding of real-world applications for machine learning, particularly in optimizing ad delivery while maintaining ethical standards. I’m also excited about opportunities to mentor junior engineers and grow alongside a team that values both innovation and integrity. Let’s build better tech, together.
